name: Augnagar
senses: greater darkvision, imprecise scent 30, true seeing

traits.name: Confusing Display
traits.text: ⬺ (concentrate, emotion, enchantment, fear, incapacitation, mental, occult, visual); The augnagar's writhing limbs and flesh seethe and squirm in a disorienting and unsettling manner. Creatures in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 34 Will save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Confusing Displays for 1 minute. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 round. Failure The creature is stupefied 1 and confused for 1 minute. Critical Failure As failure, but the creature can't attempt a flat check to recover from confusion whenever it takes damage from an attack or spell.

traits.name: Inhale Vitality
traits.text: ⬺ (necromancy, occult); Frequency once per day; The augnagar inhales sharply, drawing life force out of creatures in a 50-foot cone. Creatures in the area take 14d6 (14d6) negative damage (DC 34 basic Fortitude save, and the creature is fatigued on a failure). The augnagar becomes quickened for 1 round on its next turn, and it can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

traits.name: Rotting Curse
traits.text: (curse, disease, necromancy, occult); Saving Throw DC 34 Fortitude. Stage 1 drained 1 (1 day) Stage 2 drained 2 and the creature displays hideous, festering wounds exuding a horrific stench. (null)

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ bite +28 (chaotic, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 3d12+14 (3d12+14) piercing plus 4d6 (4d6) persistent bleed, 1d6 (1d6) chaotic, and rotting curse

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ sting +28 (agile, chaotic, magical, finesse, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d8+14 (3d8+14) slashing plus 4d6 (4d6) persistent bleed and 1d6 (1d6) chaotic
